name: clear-business-writing
description: Four skills for engineering-management business writing, derived from Josh Bernoff's Writing Without Bullshit: drafting-for-readers (RFCs, postmortems, reviews, emails, escalations, standups, blog/social/press content), diagnosing-drafts (clarity review), improving-writing-culture (team/org writing-culture and process fixes), and communicating-clearly (tightening conversational replies).
